entries.dialogueText: On entering the building, we were met by a parliamentary guide who briefed us about the procedures. After a strict security screening, the staff ushered us to the third floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I, Deivid Wisci and the rest of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I, Deivid Wisci and the rest of the Sordish delegation to the Alliance of Nations arrived in Kyrute. The local police escorted us to the Alliance's headquarters in downtown Konstantium, immediately recognizable by its shining dome.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""Mr. President, it is my pleasure t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, it is my pleasure to return to this podium."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""When I last spoke here, the messag..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I last spoke here, the message I gave was of encouragement and support to this organization and the vital role it plays."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""Of all the challenges Eastern Merk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of all the challenges Eastern Merkopa and the whole world has faced since then, one has grown larger and more imminent than any other."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""The threat of the so-called 'socia..."
entries.dialogueText: "The threat of the so-called 'socialist' states and the actions taken by their authoritarian rulers with no regard to international law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A loud noise came from the table of..."
entries.dialogueText: A loud noise came from the table of Valgsland. I saw Emmerich Hegel pounding his fists on his table in protest.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""...Today, the need to come togethe..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Today, the need to come together as the leaders of the free world is more important than ever."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""The CSP, under the leadership of U..."
entries.dialogueText: "The CSP, under the leadership of United Contana, has been fuelling Valgsland's military-industrial complex and its expansionist aims in Eastern Merkopa."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez: ""We invite all the member states to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We invite all the member states to support our call for a resolution in accordance with Article 11 of the Falenco Treaty."

entries.dialogueText: A lot of noise came from the assembly hall in response. Most of the Western Merkopan delegates were clapping, while others either shouted in protest or sat in stony silence.

entries.dialogueText: Deivid nodded in agreement.

entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""But we can't be aggressive like Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we can't be aggressive like Mr. Smolak here. We need the world powers with us, not against us."

entries.dialogueText: "So it seems."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Coming back to the claims of the L..."
entries.dialogueText: "Coming back to the claims of the Lespian representative... First, there is no evidence of civilian massacres by the Wehzek forces, nor so-called purges of minorities."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Third, we know your government is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Third, we know your government is also implicated in the funding of the BFF. And that your oil companies aided their militants during the operation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Fourth, as the state, we only took..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fourth, as the state, we only took what was ours. The companies the delegate spoke of were not only aiding militants, they were brought to Wehlen by force."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Then he looked at the Arcasian dele..."
entries.dialogueText: Then he looked at the Arcasian delegates and the Lespians next to them.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""...And enemies who want to keep it..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And enemies who want to keep it down."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Know that Wehlen will no longer re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Know that Wehlen will no longer recognize the right of any other country to determine what type of weapons we are permitted to possess or what type of policies we follow within our borders."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Wehlen stands stronger and more un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen stands stronger and more united than ever. Our people have spoken. The enemies inside our borders are crushed."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Now, I ask every delegate here to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, I ask every delegate here to read our report on the connections of the West with the armed militants in Eastern Merkopa. And I ask the Alliance of Nations to do what's right."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Wehlen only wants peace. Our peopl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen only wants peace. Our people want peace. They are counting on the support and understanding of all the nations of the world."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""Their proclamation is, 'Free Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their proclamation is, 'Free Wehlen or Death'."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""First of all, I want to extend a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I want to extend a due welcome to the new states from Rika that have joined this organization."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""As our numbers grow and more state..."
entries.dialogueText: "As our numbers grow and more states are represented in this stage, we come ever closer to finding resolutions to the conflicts that plague us."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""After fighting for years against c..."
entries.dialogueText: "After fighting for years against colonialism and imperialism, they more than earned our membership vote. I am overjoyed to see them finally represented in this assembly."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""For hundreds of years, the dominan..."
entries.dialogueText: "For hundreds of years, the dominant economies of Merkopa razed, pillaged and exploited the continents of Rika and Xina."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Sadly, Valgsland was also a part o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sadly, Valgsland was also a part of this plunder in the years before the revolution, when it still clung to the idea of imperialism."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""But when our masses found their vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But when our masses found their voice, the old colonial powers and their new financiers turned against them."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""These powers did whatever they cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "These powers did whatever they could to hamper our revolutions. They did not want the people to be heard."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""They are scared of us for showing..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are scared of us for showing the possibility of a better path. Of course they don't want us to succeed. We threaten the *productivity* that runs on the blood and sweat of their working class."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""And now they have started labellin..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now they have started labelling us the aggressors. Yet we all know it was the Arcasians who built up military bases all around Merkopa. It was the ATO that was first formed to fight against Malenyevism."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Heljiland was, is and will be Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heljiland was, is and will be Valgslandian territory. Our intervention in the island was completely justified."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Other delegates brought up the Fal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Other delegates brought up the Falenco and Ventrie City Treaties. However, they are forgetting about the Treaty of Adrium."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Valgsland exercised its right to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland exercised its right to intervene on behalf of our people, who were being oppressed and massacred by the Agnolian government just because they did not recognize an appointed governor. They didn't get to elect one."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""We acted in full accordance with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We acted in full accordance with the second article of the treaty, If there's a side to be blamed, it is the state which murders its minorities for publicly showing support to our nation."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""There were also claims about illeg..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were also claims about illegal missiles."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""No country in the world has the ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "No country in the world has the right to determine what type of weapons we import."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""If there's a conflict the Alliance..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's a conflict the Alliance can resolve, let's start with the Arcasian base on Ravnos Island. Lespia has been housing Arcasian troops and missiles by our border for years and none of the member states even talked about it."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""The delegates from Lespia and Agno..."
entries.dialogueText: "The delegates from Lespia and Agnolia brought up the Falenco Treaty."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Valgsland holds the right to prote..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland holds the right to protect its territorial waters and trade from threats."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""But what were they doing when ATO..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what were they doing when ATO forces patrolled the Antacean Sea? They were silent."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""Just as no country in the world ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as no country in the world has the right to determine what type of naval vessels we use, no country can force us not to defend our seas."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""I also want the member states to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also want the member states to look into the Arcasian bases in both Lespia and Sordland."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: ""However, the Valgslandian governme..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the Valgslandian government is ready as always to fight the forces of oppression and colonial servitude on behalf of free people everywhere."

entries.menuText: "Our century is the century of the struggle for freedom. The century of liberation from foreign occupation."

entries.dialogueText: "And now yet another Arcasian president is telling us that we are the aggressors and they are the keepers of peace."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""We will not be silent anymore agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will not be silent anymore against these lies! When was this peace you talk about? Where was this cooperation between our countries? Have you ever accepted our invitation to talk about de-nuclearization?"

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""If you don't like us, don't accept..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't like us, don't accept our deals, don't listen to our concerns, and keep pointing fingers at us, why did you invite us to the Alliance of Nations?"

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Every year, United Contana comes t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every year, United Contana comes to this assembly to address the real problems of *real* people. People who suffer because of your systems, your wars and your ignorance."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Whether you like it or not, we'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether you like it or not, we'll keep representing the laborers, the slaves, the oppressed of this world. And believe it or disregard it, history is on our side."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""We say to the representatives of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We say to the representatives of capitalist countries... Come and visit us. Come and see the revolution working in Contana."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Show our continent to your people..."
entries.dialogueText: "Show our continent to your people without distorting the reality. If you cannot do that, then you need not come."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""We believe socialism will triumph..."
entries.dialogueText: "We believe socialism will triumph over capitalism in the end. Such is the logical conclusion of the development of humankind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This time, the Lespian delegates st..."
entries.dialogueText: This time, the Lespian delegates started laughing very loudly. Some other delegates booed.
